name: Shorter codex timeout (10min vs 15min)
hypothesis: Codex iterations that succeed tend to complete within 10 minutes; iterations exceeding 10 minutes rarely recover. A 10-minute timeout will save ~5 minutes of wall-clock time per timeout without increasing failure rate
change: Reduce codex provider timeout from 15 minutes to 10 minutes in routing config
measurement: Compare timeout rate and total wall-clock time per bead over next 30 codex iterations; success rate should remain within 1 standard deviation of current
risk: Some legitimate codex completions between 10-15 minutes would be killed, potentially increasing retry cost
